title: Bit Manipulation
definition: Bit manipulation performs logical operations directly on binary bits of integers.
intuition: Fast, memory-efficient operations on numeric binaries.
how_it_works: Uses bitwise operators: AND (&), OR (|), XOR (^), NOT (~), Left Shift (<<), Right Shift (>>).
when_to_use: For subset representations, checking power of 2, toggling values, or optimization.
when_not_to_use: When code readability is high priority over minor speedups.
content: Bit manipulation performs logical operations directly on binary bits of integers.
